guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：SPARC 高場 tokamak 研究
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: SPARC high-field tokamak research
guides.concept: 以高溫超導磁體與緊湊裝置能量邊界解析SPARC 高場 tokamak 研究：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
guides.conceptEn: Explore SPARC high-field tokamak research through hts magnets and compact-device energy boundaries: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
procedure: 在「SPARC 高場 tokamak 研究」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識緊湊tokamak幾何。磁約束與慣性約束在時空尺度和能量輸送不同；研究裝置不是電廠。 建立約束方式與系統邊界的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是高溫超導磁體與緊湊裝置能量邊界。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫等離子體、加熱、磁體或光學與設施邊界。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「SPARC 高場 tokamak 研究」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識預期Q與設施邊界。等離子體或target的增益只比較指定輸入輸出；全設施需另計供電、轉換與損失。 建立加熱與能量增益的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是高溫超導磁體與緊湊裝置能量邊界。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分開Q、驅動效率、熱電效率與淨電的假想預算。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「SPARC 高場 tokamak 研究」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識HTS磁體負載。磁場幾何或光路誤差影響約束及能量耦合；平均指標不能代表所有區域。 建立磁體或光學精度的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是高溫超導磁體與緊湊裝置能量邊界。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較誤差地圖與受影響的物理邊界。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「SPARC 高場 tokamak 研究」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識緊湊壁面熱通量。熱負載受面積、時間分佈及路徑控制；延長脈衝會增加系統熱量管理需求。 建立熱排出與表面負載的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是高溫超導磁體與緊湊裝置能量邊界。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。由給定假想功率與受熱面積計算熱通量。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「SPARC 高場 tokamak 研究」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識診斷與仿真驗證。診斷觀測和反演模型不同；有限時效或遮擋會改變控制可用資訊。 建立診斷與控制證據的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是高溫超導磁體與緊湊裝置能量邊界。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分開直接量測、模型重建及誤差條。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「SPARC 高場 tokamak 研究」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識目標與已證明能力。可用率、重複率、維護及能量平衡決定電廠可行性；單次紀錄不涵蓋生命週期。 建立研究裝置與電廠差距的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是高溫超導磁體與緊湊裝置能量邊界。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。列研究已證明功能與電廠仍需驗證的功能表。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
procedureEn: Identify compact tokamak geometry in the mentor diagram and primary sources for SPARC high-field tokamak research. Magnetic/inertial confinement differ in scales and energy delivery; a research device is not a power plant. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of confinement and system boundaries, focusing on hts magnets and compact-device energy boundaries. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw plasma, heating, magnets/optics and facility boundaries. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify projected q/facility boundaries in the mentor diagram and primary sources for SPARC high-field tokamak research. Plasma/target gain compares specified inputs/outputs; facilities also need electrical/conversion losses. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of heating and gain, focusing on hts magnets and compact-device energy boundaries. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate Q, driver efficiency, conversion efficiency and assumed net power. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify hts magnet loads in the mentor diagram and primary sources for SPARC high-field tokamak research. Magnetic geometry/optical errors affect confinement/coupling; averages do not describe every region. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of magnet or optical precision, focusing on hts magnets and compact-device energy boundaries. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare error maps with affected physical boundaries. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify compact-device surface flux in the mentor diagram and primary sources for SPARC high-field tokamak research. Area, duration and paths control loads; longer pulses increase heat-management demands. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of heat exhaust and surface loads, focusing on hts magnets and compact-device energy boundaries. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Calculate heat flux from assumed power and wetted area. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify diagnostics/simulation validation in the mentor diagram and primary sources for SPARC high-field tokamak research. Observations differ from inverse-model estimates; latency/occlusion changes control information. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of diagnostics and control evidence, focusing on hts magnets and compact-device energy boundaries. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate direct measurements, reconstructions and error bars. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify goals/demonstrated capabilities in the mentor diagram and primary sources for SPARC high-field tokamak research. Availability, repetition, maintenance and balance affect viability; one record does not cover lifecycle performance. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of research-to-power-plant gaps, focusing on hts magnets and compact-device energy boundaries. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. List demonstrated research functions and remaining plant validations. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
evidence: 提交診斷與仿真驗證的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交目標與已證明能力的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交目標與已證明能力的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
evidenceEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for diagnostics/simulation validation.
Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for goals/demonstrated capabilities.
Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for goals/demonstrated capabilities.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：單次最長或最熱脈衝即可證明商業可用率。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: One longest/hottest pulse establishes commercial availability.

related.title: NIF 慣性融合能量邊界
related.why: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.whyEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.transfer: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.transferEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.difference: 本課針對高溫超導磁體與緊湊裝置能量邊界；NIF 慣性融合能量邊界改以高能雷射、增益定義與設施能量為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on hts magnets and compact-device energy boundaries; NIF inertial-fusion energy boundaries centers on high-energy lasers, gain definitions and facility energy, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照緊湊tokamak幾何與慣性約束系統邊界，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到NIF 慣性融合能量邊界，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以目標與已證明能力為起點，設計一項能區分「高溫超導磁體與緊湊裝置能量邊界」與「高能雷射、增益定義與設施能量」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare compact tokamak geometry with inertial-confinement boundaries and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to NIF inertial-fusion energy boundaries, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from goals/demonstrated capabilities and propose an observation distinguishing hts magnets and compact-device energy boundaries from high-energy lasers, gain definitions and facility energy, including uncertainty.
